coaching.headline: Steady strides, keep the heart in check 🏃‍♀️
coaching.coaching: Today's 7 km at 8:13 /​km kept your average HR at 153 bpm, comfortably under the MAF ceiling of 155 bpm, which is great. However, the pace is a bit slower than your target range (7:50‑8:10), and the max HR spiked to 161 bpm, suggesting a brief intensity surge you want to avoid.
coaching.trend: Over the past week you’ve held HR below 155 on four of six runs, showing good aerobic consistency, but the faster paces on the 7/18 and 7/17 runs pushed HR above MAF. Weekly volume remains low at 12 km, so gradual buildup will be key.
coaching.nextRun: Run 8 km at 7:55‑8:05 /​km, keep HR ≤ 154 bpm, maintain cadence ≥ 175 spm, and focus on smooth footstrike (ground contact < 280 ms).
